payload.baseline: saved canonical full positive resource ranking; no rerun
payload.coverage: ordered overlapping windows from token zero, final nonempty partial window retained, no padding; char span includes surrounding gaps to cover all source text when lexical tokens exist
payload.empty_or_no_lexical_token_resource: zero windows; filename-stem evidence remains available
payload.identity: SHA-256 of parent snapshot, resource address, ordinal, token and character half-open spans
payload.projection: maximum positive content-window score per resource plus 0.25 resource-level filename score; earliest window ordinal wins exact content ties
payload.query: exact frozen lexical_query; canonical Unicode word-span casefold; distinct terms
payload.resource_ties: canonical corpus resource order after descending combined score

scoring.formula: canonical Lucene-style BM25 arithmetic on window content corpus; k1=1.2, b=0.75, distinct query terms
scoring.positive: positive combined score from content-window or filename evidence

payload.short_resource: one window containing all lexical tokens and complete source text
payload.window_unit: 256 canonical lexical content tokens from raw parent-snapshot resource source
